ja: 何でも聞いて。
en: Ask me anything.
alternatives: Please ask me anything.
Feel free to ask me.
point: 命令文は主語なしで動詞から始める

ja: 学歴はないが、成果は出してきました。
en: Though I lack a degree, I've delivered results.
alternatives: Although I don't have a degree, I've delivered results.
I lack a degree, but I've delivered results.
point: Though 節と主節を対比させる

ja: 採用なら、すぐに戦力になります。
en: If hired, I'll hit the ground running.
alternatives: If I'm hired, I'll hit the ground running.
Once hired, I'll hit the ground running.
point: hit the ground running は「すぐ全力で動く」

ja: 視野を広げたくて応募しました。
en: I applied to broaden my horizons.
alternatives: I applied in order to broaden my horizons.
I applied hoping to broaden my horizons.
point: 目的は to + 動詞。「視野を広げる」は broaden one's horizons

ja: 即断が要る仕事に惹かれます。
en: I'm drawn to jobs demanding snap decisions.
alternatives: I'm attracted to roles that demand quick decisions.
I'm drawn to roles requiring split-second decisions.
point: jobs の後ろに -ing で修飾。惹かれる = be drawn to

ja: 営業の経験者です。
en: I'm experienced in sales.
alternatives: I have sales experience.
I've done sales work.
point: 経験者は experienced。前置詞は in

ja: 私は、着任してすぐ動ける人間です。
en: I'm someone who hits the ground running.
alternatives: I'm a person who can hit the ground running.
I'm the type who hits the ground running.
I'm someone who can start contributing right away.
point: 「すぐ動き出す」は hit the ground running

ja: 当時すでにチームを率いてた。
en: By then, I'd led a team.
alternatives: I'd already led a team by then.
By that point, I'd already led a team.
point: 「その時までに」は過去完了

ja: 営業で、交渉力を学びました。
en: Working in sales, I learned to negotiate.
alternatives: Working in sales taught me to negotiate.
Through working in sales, I learned to negotiate.
point: 分詞構文の主語は主節の主語と同じ

ja: 私が活きるのはここだと思う。
en: I think this is where I'll thrive.
alternatives: I believe this is where I'll thrive.
I think this is the place where I'll thrive.
point: I think の中に where 節を入れ子にする

ja: 残業はありますか？
en: Is there any overtime?
alternatives: Do people work overtime here?
Will there be any overtime?
point: 「残業」は数えない名詞なので any overtime

ja: 私、通勤しなきゃ。
en: I have to commute.
alternatives: I must commute.
I need to commute.
point: have to は必要性を表す。

ja: もっと早く転職すればよかった。
en: I wish I'd changed jobs sooner.
alternatives: I wish I had switched jobs earlier.
I should have changed jobs sooner.
point: 過去の後悔は wish + 過去完了

ja: 私の一番の強みは聞く力です。
en: My greatest strength is listening.
alternatives: My biggest strength is listening.
Listening is my greatest strength.
point: 「一番の強み」は最上級 greatest / biggest

ja: 転職するなら、教師になりたい。
en: If I changed careers, I'd teach.
alternatives: If I switched careers, I'd teach.
If I changed careers, I'd become a teacher.
point: 現実味の薄い仮定は if + 過去形、would で受ける

ja: メモしてもいいですか？
en: May I take notes?
alternatives: Can I take notes?
Is it okay to take notes?
point: 「メモを取る」は take notes と複数形

ja: 昨年、売上を倍にしました。
en: I doubled our sales last year.
alternatives: Last year, I doubled our sales.
I increased our sales twofold last year.
point: last year があるので過去形

ja: 上司は私なら重責も担えると言った。
en: My boss said I could shoulder serious responsibility.
alternatives: My boss said I could handle major responsibilities.
My manager said I could take on heavy responsibilities.
point: shoulder responsibility は責任を引き受け担う。

ja: 独立してたら今は私が采配を振るう。
en: Had I gone independent, I'd call the shots.
alternatives: If I'd become self-employed, I'd be in charge now.
I'd make the decisions now had I gone independent.
point: call the shots は決定権を握る。

ja: 怒ったお客様をなだめるのが得意です。
en: I have a knack for calming upset clients.
alternatives: I'm good at calming upset clients.
Calming upset clients is my forte.
I have a gift for soothing angry clients.
point: 「得意」は a knack for。冠詞 a を忘れない

ja: 案件を担当して、次は統括したい。
en: Having managed projects, I'd like to lead.
alternatives: Having run projects, I'd like to take the lead.
Having managed projects, I now want to lead.
point: Having + 過去分詞で「〜した経験を経て」

ja: 英語でメールが書けます。
en: I can write English emails.
alternatives: I can write emails in English.
I'm able to write English emails.
point: 「英語のメール」は English emails と前に置ける

ja: 私は新卒です。
en: I'm a new graduate.
alternatives: I'm a recent graduate.
I just graduated.
point: 新卒は new / recent graduate。a を付ける

ja: 私、営業を学んでる。
en: I'm learning sales.
alternatives: I'm studying sales.
I'm learning how to sell.
point: 進行形で現在取り組んでいることを表す。

ja: 人に教えるのが得意です。
en: I'm good at teaching others.
alternatives: I'm good at teaching people.
Teaching others is one of my strengths.
point: be good at のあとは動名詞（-ing）

ja: 初日はいつですか？
en: When's my first day?
alternatives: When do I start?
When is the first day?
point: 疑問詞 when を文頭に置く

ja: 私を動かすのは、成長できる機会です。
en: It's the chance to grow that drives me.
alternatives: What drives me is the chance to grow.
What motivates me is the opportunity to grow.
point: 「～こそが」は It is ～ that で強調

ja: 今、転職活動中です。
en: I'm job hunting.
alternatives: I'm looking for a new job.
I'm searching for a new job.
point: 今の状態は進行形。活動中は look for

ja: 辞めてから、フリーで働いてる。
en: I've been freelancing since I quit.
alternatives: I've freelanced since I quit my job.
I've been freelancing since I left my job.
point: since の後は過去形、主節は現在完了（進行形）

ja: 来月から働き始めます。
en: I'll start next month.
alternatives: I'm starting next month.
I'm going to start next month.
I'll start working next month.
point: これからの意思は will。next に前置詞は不要

ja: リーダーに抜擢されたんです。
en: I was tapped to lead the team.
alternatives: I was picked to lead the team.
They chose me to lead the team.
point: be tapped to do で「抜擢される」

ja: 勤務地を教えてください。
en: Please tell me where I'd work.
alternatives: Could you tell me where I'd work?
Could you tell me the work location?
I'd like to know where I'd work.
point: 間接疑問は where のあとが平叙文の語順

ja: 私はチームで最年少でした。
en: I was the team's youngest member.
alternatives: I was the youngest on the team.
I was the youngest person on the team.
point: 最年少は the youngest。the を忘れずに

ja: リーダー経験があります。
en: I've been a team leader.
alternatives: I have leadership experience.
I've led teams before.
point: 経験は現在完了 have + 過去分詞

ja: もっと強く異を唱えるべきだった。
en: I should have pushed back harder.
alternatives: I ought to have pushed back harder.
I should've objected more strongly.
point: 「反対する」は push back。後悔は should have done

ja: 大事なのは、信頼です。
en: What matters most is trust.
alternatives: Trust is what matters most.
The most important thing is trust.
point: 「〜なのは」は What ～ is の形

ja: その経験が私を強くしました。
en: That experience made me stronger.
alternatives: That experience toughened me up.
I became stronger because of that experience.
point: make + 人 + 形容詞「人を〜にする」

ja: 上司に応募を勧められた。
en: My boss encouraged me to apply.
alternatives: My boss suggested I apply.
My boss urged me to apply.
point: encourage 人 to do の形

ja: プロダクト管理に領域を広げたいです。
en: I want to branch out into product management.
alternatives: I'd like to branch out into product management.
I want to expand into product management.
point: branch out (into) は「領域を広げる」

ja: 楽してたら私のキャリアは停滞してた。
en: Had I coasted, I'd have stalled professionally.
alternatives: If I'd coasted, my career would have stagnated.
My career would've stalled had I taken it easy.
point: coast は努力せず惰性で進むこと。

ja: 研修はありますか？
en: Is there training?
alternatives: Is training available?
Do you offer training?
point: training は数えないので there is を使う。
